description: This file defines a PHP class 'CleanUpInstallAPI' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling API requests related to cleaning up or rolling back installation states during the setup process.

classes.name: CleanUpInstallAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for handling cleanup operations during the installation process, such as dropping the database or cleaning up after a failed installation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to perform cleanup actions based on the database type, either dropping the database or cleaning up after a failed install.
